about: The identity of the console and the site, in one place: the approved design (direction C, second version). scripts/tokens.ts writes css/tokens.css, css/theme.css and src/tokens.ts from this file. Silks and chords never carry text: text always sits on a solid base, and a silk only shows as a surface with a solid hem. Each pair is a foreground and a background the pages really put together, with the contrast it must reach.
pairs: text on the stone: site and console
text on solid bases: panels, fields, the chosen plan, the decision
text in the shade: hover, table heads
secondary text on panels and fields
the artists' share in panels, the rejected state
the campaign's label, the service's commercial choice
links, the list price after an offer
links in panels, the scheduled state
chosen segment, the failed state, notices
a row reached by a link, selected text
secondary text on the dark rail (at least 7:1, beyond the 4.5:1 that text needs)
the current entry of the rail
the focus ring, the indigo hem
the artists' minimum cord, the madder hem
borders of the panels that matter (decision, consent)
the border of the role switch on the rail
the focus ring on the rail
